$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the time-sensitive facts about Moses Kolleh Sesay.
The same employment dates, degrees, certifications and profile links were
written out by hand in index.html, its JSON-LD block, field-report.html, the
narration scripts, the README and the CV. Six copies of a fact is six chances
for them to disagree, and they already had: field-report.html listed a
certification the rest of the site did not.
Nothing generates the pages from this file — the site is deliberately a
no-build static site, and turning it into a templated one is a bigger change
than the problem warrants. Instead tests/content.test.js reads this file and
fails if any page disagrees with it. Edit here first, then make the pages
match; the test tells you which ones are behind.
`verifiedOn` is the date a human last confirmed the ongoing facts (the
'Present' role in particular) were still true. The test prints a loud notice
